title: Final Save / Migration Golden Manifest
strongMetaSeparationRequired: run.strongMetaRuntime counters tied to frozen snapshot
forbiddenInferencePolicy: readiness is not ending or route selection
generic debt is not Secret Debt
Street housing is not D51 provenance
Palace access is not Palace duty progress
palace.progression-complete alone is not fifteen committed duties
Prince readiness is not Prince defeat
Camp progress is not inferred from day/checkpoint/Field Time
earned Hard Work is not active D47 package selection
historical lumber-stay/vitality is not modern ending/Hard Work/Strong Meta slot

cases.name: case 01: schema ladder reaches one final schema and parse twice is idempotent

before: raw schema1/schema2/schema3/schema4/schema5 incomplete/schema5 complete/pre-late schema6
afterReload: after first parse capture final schema,pending,RNG,journal,transaction; serialize and parse again

rejectionDefaultRules: unsupported or ambiguous schema/date rejects; supported late fields default deterministically
rewardOwnershipChecks: no reward/transaction may grow on second parse
forbiddenInferences: do not invent historical fields; do not wrap invalid historical date; do not label F1 genuine
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Freeze final schema epoch and run every supported historical row through the actual assembled migration chain.
stopConditions: final schema epoch is not frozen
unsupported historical state is silently accepted

cases.name: case 02: legacy ended run receives exactly one RunResult transaction

before: legacy ended+committed save without modern result/proof
afterReload: after first load; after second load

rejectionDefaultRules: legacy ended state gets deterministic compatibility result/proof once
rewardOwnershipChecks: reward list cannot grow on reload; transaction count exactly one
forbiddenInferences: do not mint a second transaction; do not replay completion reward
stopConditions: resultId or transactionId changes on second load

cases.name: case 03: Strong Meta migration and protected profile merge never rewrite the current run

before: schema5 incomplete creation; schema5 completed creation; imported older Meta plus richer current profile
afterReload: after migration; after protected merge; second parse

rejectionDefaultRules: incomplete creation stays snapshot-free; completed legacy creation gets compatibility snapshot
rewardOwnershipChecks: permanent ownership may union; run snapshot/runtime remain frozen; package snapshot remains separate
forbiddenInferences: do not rebuild current-run snapshot from newer profile; do not infer package selection from ownership
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Re-run after D38/Secret Debt/Palace reward registry composition on the final target.
stopConditions: Hard Work packages consume Strong Meta slots

cases.name: case 04: D40 selected-route repair is conservative and idempotent

before: each unambiguous legacy route-specific stage; generic outcome-ready; existing selected fact; overlapping selected facts
afterReload: after first parse; after second parse

rejectionDefaultRules: only exact one-to-one historical stage may add its matching selected fact
rewardOwnershipChecks: no Specialist/completion ownership is granted from readiness repair
forbiddenInferences: do not infer route selection from generic readiness; do not erase existing selected facts
stopConditions: second parse adds another/different route fact

cases.name: case 05: D41 completed legacy Tavern migration canonicalizes once and Specialist ownership dedupes

before: completed tavern-stay/tavern-guild/tavern-court; eligible-only; committed unfinished; old reward evidence; protected merge
afterReload: after canonicalization; second parse; protected profile merge

rejectionDefaultRules: completed legacy IDs canonicalize; eligible-only removed; unfinished commit resets without completion
rewardOwnershipChecks: canonical Specialist ownership at most once through canonical Strong Meta path
forbiddenInferences: do not turn eligibility or unfinished commit into completion
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Re-run after final Strong Meta registry composition.

cases.name: case 06: retired lumber-stay vitality migration preserves history without creating a modern ending

before: eligible-only; committed unfinished; completed with existing RunResult; completed pre-RunResult; vitality-only; both evidence; no evidence; protected merge
afterReload: after first migration; after second parse/profile merge

rejectionDefaultRules: eligible-only removed without reward; unfinished commit resumes active; historical completion preserved; pre-RunResult gets compatibility proof
rewardOwnershipChecks: legacy perk owns +1 Energy slot-free; no Strong Meta/Hard Work conversion; no modern reward replay
forbiddenInferences: do not fabricate a modern ending; do not convert vitality into Strong Meta or Hard Work; do not relabel F4/F5 genuine
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Assemble retirement before final ending/reference validation and run against the final catalog.
stopConditions: live lumber-stay remains in modern catalog

cases.name: case 07: NightFlow atomic reload matrix is exactly once at every phase

before: before lodging; after lodging payment; pending forced event; after voluntary choice; queued next-day modifier; after calendar commit/start-day completion
afterReload: reload at every checkpoint and continue once against uninterrupted control

rejectionDefaultRules: persist handled event/choice/provenance state; no phase rollback
rewardOwnershipChecks: no duplicated lodging cost or next-day effect
forbiddenInferences: do not reroll pending variant; do not replay forced resolution

cases.name: case 08: pre-Secret-Debt saves default unseen and typed Secret Debt states roundtrip exactly

before: schema6 save with carrier absent; unseen/refused/accepted/bound/paid-freedom/takeover
afterReload: after first parse; after serialize+parse

rejectionDefaultRules: absent carrier defaults exactly to unseen; typed state roundtrips exactly
rewardOwnershipChecks: no reward ownership is inferred from state defaulting
forbiddenInferences: do not infer Secret Debt from generic debt, Street housing, money, Lust, text or history
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Assemble typed Secret Debt into the final schema and capture the exact absent-carrier historical boundary.

cases.name: case 09: Secret Debt lender acceptance and ten-day trap cannot replay or backdate forced Night

before: before lender roll; pending lender encounter; immediately after accept; day 9 before Night; exact day 10 activation; immediately after activation
afterReload: reload at each checkpoint and compare uninterrupted control

rejectionDefaultRules: acceptedDay/trapDay persist; exact trap boundary activates once
rewardOwnershipChecks: no ending/reward ownership at trap activation
forbiddenInferences: do not reroll lender attempt; do not backdate bound-night penalty to preceding Night
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Compose Secret Debt with final NightFlow and run exact day-boundary reload matrix.
stopConditions: preceding Night receives retroactive bound penalty

cases.name: case 10: Secret Debt forced Night and D51 provenance queue are reload-safe

before: bound normal/cheap/Street; before forced choice; after forced choice/queued tags; before start-day processing
afterReload: reload before/after forced choice and before start-day processing

rejectionDefaultRules: forced before-lodging Debt Night has priority; queued tags persist and clear once
rewardOwnershipChecks: no reward ownership at Night boundary
forbiddenInferences: do not run voluntary/D42 Night in parallel; do not synthesize provenance from housing alone
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Assemble Secret Debt+D51 on the same Night/start-day path and execute as one integration case.

cases.name: case 11: D51 compatibility is provenance-gated and never a global Energy floor

before: base Energy3+both tags; Energy4+both tags; Street only; bound only; both+unrelated third -1; Street housing without tag
afterReload: after start-day processing; reload after tags clear

rejectionDefaultRules: compatibility floor applies only to the exact provenance pair
rewardOwnershipChecks: Strong Meta/legacy Energy modifiers contribute to effective base but are not provenance tags
forbiddenInferences: do not implement global Math.max(2,...); do not infer Street tag from housing
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Run producer T1-T11 against final energyMax/start-day composition.
stopConditions: unrelated third penalty is clamped away
Street without tag receives compatibility floor

cases.name: case 12: Secret Debt hidden-work repay Takeover and ending ledger never replay

before: hidden shift 49->50; 74->75; after full 20000 repay; after Takeover; each ending committed/completed; second reload/profile merge
afterReload: reload across each atomic boundary; second load after ending completion

rejectionDefaultRules: thresholds/repayment/transitions occur once; reward only on completion transaction
rewardOwnershipChecks: canonical rewards secret-debt.paid-freedom.earned-reserve-match, secret-debt.bound-life.work-rhythm, secret-debt.takeover.network-retainer owned once; no generic duplicate
forbiddenInferences: do not apply Earned Reserve Match to bound hidden work; do not grant ending reward at commit
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Bind Secret Debt ending rewards to final Strong Meta registry and execute route checkpoints.

cases.name: case 13: old Palace access without Rich6 ledger gets neutral progression while access is preserved

before: accepted D23 access fact present; no run.progression.palace; no progression-complete
afterReload: after migration; second parse

rejectionDefaultRules: preserve access; create exact neutral Palace ledger; strip obsolete generic unlock if present
rewardOwnershipChecks: no reward/ending ownership inferred from access
forbiddenInferences: do not infer duty count, advanced stage, Prince defeat or outcome readiness; do not manufacture F3 from arbitrary final fresh save
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Build F3 from an accepted D23 access host on the assembled target, then migrate.

cases.name: case 14: ambiguous Palace progression-complete without duty proof is never fabricated into fifteen duties

before: palace.progression-complete present without exact committed-duty proof
afterReload: after attempted load under final approved policy

rejectionDefaultRules: must use one explicitly approved historical mapping OR explicit compatibility rejection
rewardOwnershipChecks: no ending/reward ownership may be inferred from ambiguous completion fact
forbiddenInferences: never synthesize 15 duties/counters from progression-complete alone
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Freeze one final approved policy: explicit documented mapping or explicit rejection.
stopConditions: runtime neither maps explicitly nor rejects

cases.name: case 15: Prince confrontation resumes exact authored phase and Return Home remains explicit

before: 12x91 ready undefeated; pending phase1/2/3/4; back-out/failure; immediate post-success; Return Home eligible/uncommitted/committed/completed
afterReload: reload each pending phase and after success/ending completion

rejectionDefaultRules: pending quest/choice resumes exactly; readiness is non-terminal; Return Home explicit
rewardOwnershipChecks: Return Home reward only on completed ending transaction
forbiddenInferences: do not infer Prince defeat from 12x91 readiness; do not auto-commit Return Home
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Assemble Prince narrative + final Palace ending path and serialize every authored phase.

cases.name: case 16: Activity entry route checkpoint and RNG reload do not recharge or reinterpret the envelope

before: after 2-Energy entry; after route selection; after one option; before success/result; before escape
afterReload: reload each checkpoint and compare uninterrupted control

rejectionDefaultRules: definitionVersion/adapter mismatch rejects; compatible envelope resumes exactly
rewardOwnershipChecks: result effects never replay on reload
forbiddenInferences: do not reinterpret incompatible definition/adapter; do not refund/recharge entry Energy
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Re-run against final Activity definitions/catalog after all content assembly.

cases.name: case 17: legacy Activity Field Time and mini-game state migrate conservatively

before: F2 pre-Field-Time envelope lacking fieldTimeRemaining/miniGames; modern nonzero suspicion/status/choiceIds
afterReload: after migration; modern parse/serialize/parse

rejectionDefaultRules: old envelope receives only historically approved fallback/defaults; modern mini-game state roundtrips
rewardOwnershipChecks: migration must not replay result/progression transition
forbiddenInferences: do not insert later route/option fields into F2; do not label F2 genuine; do not invent mini-game progress
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Embed F2 into a historically compatible full-save host on the final target and run the real migration.

cases.name: case 18: old active Activity gets only the exact neutral Camp default and partial Camp state rejects

before: old active envelope with both Camp fields absent; only version absent; only state absent; impossible phase/commit combo
afterReload: after load/default or rejection; second parse for valid old envelope

rejectionDefaultRules: both fields absent -> exact neutral Camp state; partial/incompatible state rejects
rewardOwnershipChecks: no reward ownership at Camp migration
forbiddenInferences: do not infer Camp from day, checkpoint or Field Time
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Port executable-green Camp delta onto final Activity schema without wholesale historical overwrite.
stopConditions: partial Camp state is defaulted instead of rejected

cases.name: case 19: Camp atomic boundary reload matrix preserves two-night cap and exactly-once calendar and Field Time

before: before Camp choice; chosen; calendar_advanced; field_day_ready; after first; after second; attempted third
afterReload: reload each boundary and compare uninterrupted control

rejectionDefaultRules: third Camp rejects; phase commits persist exactly
rewardOwnershipChecks: Camp itself grants no ending/Strong Meta reward
forbiddenInferences: do not charge city lodging; do not run ordinary city Night; do not globally refresh daily Energy
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Run the full two-night Camp matrix on final Activity schema.
stopConditions: calendar increments twice for one Camp

cases.name: case 20: Camp cannot suppress Secret Debt forced Night or lose the next-day Debt consequence

before: bound Activity at Camp boundary non-Street/Street; before interception; after forced Night selection; before D51 start-day
afterReload: reload before/after interception and before start-day processing

rejectionDefaultRules: Secret Debt forced Night preempts Camp before Camp calendar commit; D51 owns next-day pair once
rewardOwnershipChecks: no Camp/Debt reward ownership at boundary
forbiddenInferences: do not let Camp suppress forced Night; do not also advance Camp calendar/Field Time after preemption
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Execute only on the fully composed Activity+Camp+SecretDebt+D51 target.
stopConditions: Camp advances calendar despite forced Night preemption

cases.name: case 21: D38 Activity ending eligibility stays non-terminal and canonical Specialist reward ownership applies once

before: Pathfinder/Preservation/Network eligibility; explicit commit; completion; second load; protected merge
afterReload: reload at eligibility, after commit, after completion, after profile merge

rejectionDefaultRules: eligibility is non-terminal; commit alone grants no reward
rewardOwnershipChecks: each Specialist ID owned exactly once in meta.strongMeta; no duplicate generic unlock
forbiddenInferences: do not auto-commit from eligibility; do not preserve a second generic ownership seam
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Bind D38 reward IDs through the final Strong Meta registry and execute all three endings.

cases.name: case 22: D46 existing Lust and D47 package snapshot preserve old lives and apply new packages once

before: legacy Lust1; typed Lust17; fresh post-D46; migrated completed pre-D47; pre-finish package subset; post-finish subset; Prostitute package
afterReload: reload before finishCreation; reload after finishCreation

rejectionDefaultRules: old stored Lust unchanged; fresh Lust=5; no retroactive package application; selected snapshot persists
rewardOwnershipChecks: D47 packages are outside Strong Meta slots; Prostitute +5 Lust is one package component applied once
forbiddenInferences: do not infer active packages from earned Hard Work; do not rewrite old Lust to 5; do not apply D47 retroactively
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Assemble D46+D47 with final creation ordering, then execute pre/post-finish reloads.

cases.name: case 23: D23 package identity and content-presentation-only tranches are save-neutral

before: New Start+ all ten active packages with representative pending/RNG/current-run snapshot; serialize before content layers
afterReload: load/serialize on final content catalog and compare mechanical snapshot

rejectionDefaultRules: only approved content-reference validation/presentation lookup may differ; mechanics must remain identical
rewardOwnershipChecks: Strong Meta slots remain separate from ten package identities; content/presentation adds no rewards
forbiddenInferences: do not let localization/presentation mutate Save fields,RNG,reward IDs,conditions/effects,ending eligibility or transactions
cases.postIntegrationRequirement: Run mechanical before/after snapshot on final D38 v17 + Palace v19 + localization/presentation stack.
stopConditions: any content/presentation-only tranche mutates mechanical save state
D23 counts bonus components instead of 10 identities
